status: external daily recovery job required; not a free-web task
schedule: daily in a separately authorized external job
requirements: Query the real PG16/17 server major and use apps.backup.postgres_client.client_binary with that major.
Use the shared connection helper and a temporary mode-0600 PGPASSFILE; never URL/password argv or PGPASSWORD.
Use app-only registered schema capture for shared provider databases; never silently include auth/storage/realtime schemas.
Stream/encrypt with an escrowed age recipient, retain independent signing/config/PII keys and object custody.
Upload to independent private offsite storage with separately scoped credentials, then fully re-read and verify SHA-256.
Record actual DB and object recovery points, retention, drill and key readability; independent snapshots are not an atomic recovery set.
Use an eligible existing portable tenant dump only after scratch/transport/anchor-absence qualification and its supported supervised target import.
not_equivalent: Raw SQL backup is not a compound H1 archive.
Ordinary tenant archives remain archive-and-purge records and cannot be restored.
Supabase Free durability is not an included automatic DB backup guarantee.

owners.Q: live external job, SHA-256 read-back and offline recovery drill evidence
